what_it_does: Presents Tropical, a scheduling system for serving large language models efficiently across multiple machines. LLM serving splits into two phases: prefill (processing all input tokens at once to compute initial attention state) and decode (generating output one token at a time). Disaggregated systems put prefill and decode on separate machines to avoid interference, but then cause delays from requests waiting in queues. Tropical dynamically assigns prefill and decode work to hybrid workers (machines doing both), reducing queue delays while controlling compute interference, to meet latency targets for both TTFT (time to first token) and TPOT (time per output token).
